framework: NVIDIA NeMo / Megatron-Bridge recipe of the MLPerf Training v6.1 release 20261006, on NVIDIA NGC PyTorch 26.09 (public base), with Firmus kernels compiled from source
implementation_source: NVIDIA llama31_8b reference implementation (MLPerf Training v6.1, 20261006) + Firmus patches (firmus/patches) and kernels (firmus/ak); see README.md and KERNELS.md in implementations/nemo_l4_nvfp4_v3

container.built: 2026-10-14, docker build of the implementation directory (build context: BUILD_CONTEXT.sha256)

config_file: config_GB300_2x4x2xtp1pp1cp1_8b_l4.sh (sources NVIDIA's config_GB300_2x4x2xtp1pp1cp1_8b.sh unchanged + the Firmus AK_* switches, with AK_FP4G_NOOVERLAP=1: no forward parameter gather overlaps compute)
custom_kernels: 16 Firmus kernels (K1-K16) and 16 patch, wiring and configuration items (N1-N16). K3 is shipped but never launched with the recipe's shapes, and of K1 only the angle table runs. Every kernel and every item with a numerical role is bit-identical to the stock computation (equivalence class E0), except K6's gradient-norm pass, which keeps subnormal partial sums that TE's fast-math kernel flushes and is bit-identical outside that never-observed domain (class E0-restricted), N4, which is bit-identical outside a stated subnormal input domain that a census of a whole run found empty (class E0-restricted), and N7, which is bit-identical up to the sign of an exact zero (class E0 in value); N14-N16 have no numerical role. In L4 v3, N11 also finishes every forward parameter gather at its dispatch (AK_FP4G_NOOVERLAP=1), which moves stream waits and changes no value. Listed with evidence in implementations/nemo_l4_nvfp4_v3/KERNELS.md and KERNELS/
launcher: implementations/nemo_l4_nvfp4_v3/run.sub (differences from NVIDIA's run.sub: run.sub.vs_nvidia1006.diff in this directory)
result_logs: results/firmus_gb300_ngpu8_llama8b_l4_nvfp4_v3/llama31_8b/result_0..9.txt: the raw logs after redact_logs.sh in this directory (internal storage paths redacted on non-MLLOG lines; MLLOG lines unchanged)
